text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Today's party is a private 
reservation. Please make yourselves at 
home, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Looks like there's a little bit of 
food left.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Is this... a blue cake and green 
cookies...? And... jelly sushi...?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The food here is so colorful and 
delicious. It'd be such a waste to leave 
it... Would you like some, Messiah?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not hungry? Well then, I'll go ahead 
and help myself♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Ooh!♪ It really is delicious, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
She finished that entire portion in the 
blink of an eye...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Someone put a lot of hard work into making 
this. It'd be a waste to leave any behind!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's gotta have fun♪ After all, 
that's what a party is!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! To think there'd still be 
leftovers!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I shall partake as well. For I, too, am 
a member that constitutes this party.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
! ...Thanks, Messiah! I'll go clean up 
over there!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Understood. Leave things here to me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...This is quite a hefty portion, but... 
no. I will find a way to finish every last 
bite."
choice_data_list:
You shouldn't eat it all at once like 
that...!
I wonder what it tastes like!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—Then at least eat what you can today. I 
will go ask if we may take the rest to go.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It looks like takeout won't be a problem. 
Now then... what should we eat today?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...This is still good. This... let's eat 
it now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Air Messiah successfully navigated 
the party food while making sure not to 
overeat.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Now I'm starting to look forward to 
it too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...It's not... too sweet. It's delicious, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah polished off every single one 
of the unusually colored sweets!
